title: Add native Control readiness workspace
summary: Bring the accepted Studio/Control Top 10 readiness work into the native macOS HumbleStudio inspector as a read-only surface for safe-edit parity, JSON recovery, edit intents, connection health, ticket/lane preflight, navigation, apply design, HumbleSudoku fidelity, density/readability, and write-contract preview.
acceptance_criteria: The macOS sidebar exposes a native Control readiness workspace instead of relying on the legacy web fallback.
The native readiness page presents exactly the ten requested readiness slices with writes:false, sourceWrites:false, and apply locked.
The page can consume the HumbleControl readiness endpoint when available and falls back to a local read-only contract when Control is offline.

The page includes native sections for safe-edit detail, JSON recovery, edit intents, connection diagnostics, ticket/lane preflight, unified navigation, locked apply design, HumbleSudoku preview fidelity, workspace readability, and write-contract preview.
Native build and repository checks prove the new macOS source compiles without enabling repository writes.

evidence.note: The macOS sidebar and detail switch now expose a native Control readiness workspace.
The native page renders the ten requested readiness slices with writes:false, sourceWrites:false, and apply locked in the fallback contract.
The view tries HUMBLECONTROL_URL, HUMBLESTUDIO_CONTROL_URL, and local Control ports before falling back to a read-only local pack when Control is offline.
